name: LabPilot Voice
summary: Capture EXP-042 measurements hands-free with safe parsing, duplicate protection, and a live OD600 experiment view.
description: A production-polished connected voice workflow for the fixed EXP-042 Inulin Bacterial Growth Experiment. It writes to the shared LabOS dataset, rejects uncertain numbers, and keeps scientific queries from interrupting the active session.

preferences.name: LABPILOT_API_TOKEN
preferences.title: LabOS connection token
preferences.description: Authenticates VoiceOS to the private LabOS experiment API.
preferences.placeholder: Paste the token configured for the LabOS deployment

preferences.name: LABPILOT_API_URL
preferences.title: LabOS API URL
preferences.description: Override only when connecting to another LabOS deployment.

tools.name: start_lab_session
tools.title: Start lab session
tools.description: Start or resume the persistent hands-free session for EXP-042 without clearing saved data. Use when the user says to start the lab session or begin hands-free capture.

root.html:
Begin EXP-042

Resume contextual voice capture without clearing saved measurements.

Ready for the next unrecorded sample

tools.name: get_next_step
tools.title: Next step
tools.description: Read EXP-042 and identify the next unrecorded required sample. Use only when the researcher explicitly asks what to do next.

tools.name: get_experiment_snapshot
tools.title: Experiment snapshot
tools.description: Read EXP-042 and show the live OD600 view, current voice state, latest measurement, and sample progress. Use for the dashboard, current results, or what has been recorded; this never interrupts the active session.

tools.name: query_sample
tools.title: Query sample
tools.description: Return the latest saved reading for one EXP-042 sample and highlight it without changing or stopping the active hands-free session. Use for questions such as 'What is Sample C?'.

sampleId.description: Sample identifier, such as B or Sample B

tools.name: summarize_experiment
tools.title: Summarize experiment
tools.description: Calculate a concise summary, highest latest OD600, and concentration pattern from saved EXP-042 observations without changing the active session. Use for summaries, highest OD, or scientific insight.

tools.name: compare_samples
tools.title: Compare samples
tools.description: Compare the latest saved OD600 values for two EXP-042 samples without changing the active session. Use for requests such as 'Compare A and D'.

tools.name: interpret_observation
tools.title: Interpret observation
tools.description: Parse a spoken wet-lab input without saving. During an active session, use for short sample values, explicit corrections, and undo. Never infer a numerically uncertain value; follow nextAction immediately and ask only the returned short clarification.

tools.name: record_observation
tools.title: Record observation
tools.description: Save one complete normalized voice observation to EXP-042. Call immediately after a complete interpretation. Exact same sample, measurement type, and value within eight seconds is deduplicated; intentional later repeats remain separate history records.

root.html: Record structured measurement

tools.name: correct_last
tools.title: Correct last observation
tools.description: Replace exactly the immediately previous EXP-042 observation after explicit correction language such as 'Actually, make that…'. Use correctionArgs returned by interpret_observation.

root.html: Correct latest record

tools.name: undo_last
tools.title: Undo last observation
tools.description: Remove exactly the immediately previous EXP-042 observation after 'Undo that'. Use undoArgs returned by interpret_observation; session progress and the latest-value chart update immediately.

root.html: Undo latest recordREMOVE

tools.name: check_readiness
tools.title: Check readiness
tools.description: Check VoiceOS input, parser availability, EXP-042 context, and writable local storage. Use only for troubleshooting before a demo or lab run.
